title: Ravena — Economia
description: Painel da economia (Zinthos, Petalitas, Runas). Fonte: analytics.db publicado de hora em hora pela ravena-ai. Mapeamento motivo → tipo e nomes em src/services/EconomyAnalyticsMapping.js. O analytics.db guarda epoch em ms; o frser-sqlite-datasource lê colunas de tempo em segundos, por isso o / 1000 nos SELECT.

target.queryText: SELECT ts / 1000 AS time, label AS text, COALESCE(currency, 'todas') AS tags FROM annotations WHERE (currency IS NULL OR currency = '${moeda}') AND ts >= $__from - 12 * 604800000 AND ts < $__to
target.rawQueryText: SELECT ts / 1000 AS time, label AS text, COALESCE(currency, 'todas') AS tags FROM annotations WHERE (currency IS NULL OR currency = '${moeda}') AND ts >= $__from - 12 * 604800000 AND ts < $__to

panels.title: Estado
Confiança: de quando são os dados (agora)
panels.description: Até que hora cheia cada fonte está carregada. A carga roda no minuto 5, então o atraso normal fica entre ~0,1 e ~1,1 h; acima de 2 h a carga está falhando (ver Último erro). Petalitas: o Jardim ainda não tem extrato, só o saldo. Limites de cor PROVISÓRIOS, ponto de partida para calibrar.

targets.queryText:
WITH cur(currency, nome, ordem) AS (VALUES ('zinthos', 'Zinthos', 1), ('petalitas', 'Petalitas', 2), ('runas', 'Runas', 3))
SELECT cur.nome AS "Fonte",
  (SELECT MAX(window_to) FROM load_runs l WHERE l.source = cur.currency AND l.ok = 1) / 1000 AS "Dados até",
  ROUND((CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000
         - (SELECT MAX(window_to) FROM load_runs l WHERE l.source = cur.currency AND l.ok = 1)) / 3600000.0, 1) AS "Atraso (h)",
  CASE COALESCE((SELECT available FROM ledger_status s WHERE s.currency = cur.currency), -1)
    WHEN 1 THEN 'com extrato' WHEN 0 THEN 'sem extrato' ELSE 'sem dados' END AS "Extrato",
  (SELECT CASE WHEN ok = 0 THEN error END FROM load_runs l WHERE l.source = cur.currency ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) AS "Último erro"
FROM cur ORDER BY cur.ordem

panels.title: Veredito por moeda (últimos 7 dias)
panels.description: Situação = o pior entre: crescimento da massa na semana (ok até 1%, atenção até 3%, agir acima, nos dois sentidos) e moeda sem origem na semana, em % da massa (0,1% / 0,5%) e em % do que foi criado (1% / 5%). Dobra em = semanas para a massa dobrar no ritmo desta semana (ln 2 / ln(1+g)). Moeda sem origem = Δ massa − Σ(entradas − saídas) do extrato: positivo apareceu sem linha no extrato, negativo sumiu. Zinthos e Runas já nascem em 'agir' por buracos de extrato conhecidos (give-all, sobra do confisco, créditos de Runas sem linha); é esperado. Crescimento fica vazio na primeira semana de cargas. Limites de cor PROVISÓRIOS, ponto de partida para calibrar.

targets.queryText:
WITH cur(currency, nome, ordem) AS (VALUES ('zinthos', 'Zinthos', 1), ('petalitas', 'Petalitas', 2), ('runas', 'Runas', 3)), snap AS (
  SELECT currency, ts, total, (ts - 25200000) / 86400000 AS d,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY currency, (ts - 25200000) / 86400000 ORDER BY ts) AS rn
  FROM balances
),
op AS (SELECT currency, d, ts, total FROM snap WHERE rn = 1),
dl AS (
  SELECT currency, d, ts AS ta, total AS t0,
         LEAD(d) OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY d) AS d_next,
         LEAD(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY d) AS tb,
         LEAD(total) OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY d) AS t1
  FROM op
),
x AS (
  SELECT dl.currency, dl.d, dl.d_next - dl.d AS dias, dl.t1 AS total_fim,
         (dl.t1 - dl.t0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(f.amount_in - f.amount_out) FROM flows_hourly f
                               WHERE f.currency = dl.currency AND f.kind <> 'non_monetary'
                                 AND f.hour >= dl.ta - dl.ta % 3600000
                                 AND f.hour <  dl.tb - dl.tb % 3600000), 0) AS so
  FROM dl
  WHERE dl.tb IS NOT NULL
    AND COALESCE((SELECT available FROM ledger_status s WHERE s.currency = dl.currency), 1) = 1
),
b AS (
  SELECT cur.currency, cur.nome, cur.ordem,
    (SELECT total FROM balances x WHERE x.currency = cur.currency AND x.ts <= $__to ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) AS massa,
    (SELECT total FROM balances x WHERE x.currency = cur.currency AND x.ts <= $__to - 604800000 ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) AS massa_antes,
    (SELECT MAX(ts) FROM balances x WHERE x.currency = cur.currency AND x.ts <= $__to) AS ts_dados,
    (SELECT SUM(amount_in) FROM flows_hourly f WHERE f.currency = cur.currency AND f.kind IN ('creation', 'destruction')
       AND f.hour >= $__to - 604800000 AND f.hour < $__to) AS criado,
    (SELECT SUM(so) FROM x WHERE x.currency = cur.currency
       AND x.d * 86400000 + 25200000 >= $__to - 604800000 AND x.d * 86400000 + 25200000 < $__to) AS so7,
    (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT l.label FROM reason_labels l WHERE l.currency = f.currency AND l.reason = f.reason), f.reason) FROM flows_hourly f WHERE f.currency = cur.currency AND f.kind = 'creation'
       AND f.hour >= $__to - 604800000 AND f.hour < $__to GROUP BY f.reason ORDER BY SUM(f.amount_in) DESC LIMIT 1) AS maior_fonte,
    COALESCE((SELECT available FROM ledger_status s WHERE s.currency = cur.currency), 1) AS avail
  FROM cur
),
c AS (
  SELECT *,
    (massa - massa_antes) * 1.0 / NULLIF(ABS(massa_antes), 0) AS g,
    100.0 * ABS(so7) / NULLIF(ABS(massa), 0) AS so_massa,
    100.0 * ABS(so7) / NULLIF(criado, 0) AS so_criado
  FROM b
),
n AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE WHEN g IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN ABS(g) * 100 <= 1 THEN 0 WHEN ABS(g) * 100 <= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS lv_g,
    CASE WHEN avail = 0 OR so7 IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE MAX(
      CASE WHEN so_massa IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN so_massa < 0.1 THEN 0 WHEN so_massa < 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
      CASE WHEN so_criado IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN so_criado < 1 THEN 0 WHEN so_criado < 5 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END) END AS lv_so
  FROM c
)
SELECT nome AS "Moeda",
  CASE COALESCE(MAX(COALESCE(lv_g, -1), COALESCE(lv_so, -1)), -1)
    WHEN 0 THEN 'ok' WHEN 1 THEN 'atenção' WHEN 2 THEN 'agir' ELSE 'sem dados' END
    || CASE WHEN avail = 0 THEN ' · sem extrato' ELSE '' END AS "Situação",
  ROUND(100.0 * g, 2) AS "Crescimento na semana (%)",
  CASE WHEN g > 0 THEN ROUND(ln(2) / ln(1 + g), 1) END AS "Dobra em (semanas)",
  CASE WHEN avail = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(100.0 * so7 / NULLIF(criado, 0), 2) END AS "Sem origem (% do criado)",
  CASE WHEN avail = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(100.0 * so7 / NULLIF(ABS(massa), 0), 3) END AS "Sem origem (% da massa)",
  CASE WHEN avail = 0 THEN 'sem extrato' ELSE maior_fonte END AS "Maior fonte",
  ts_dados / 1000 AS "Dados até"
FROM n ORDER BY ordem

panels.title: De onde vem e para onde vai — ${moeda} (últimos 7 dias)
panels.description: Extrato da moeda escolhida (seletor no topo) por motivo. Tipo vem do mapeamento da ravena (EconomyAnalyticsMapping.js): 'Sem mapeamento' = motivo novo que alguém precisa mapear; 'Fora do dinheiro' (ex.: waifu confiscada na taxa de hospedagem) não mexe no saldo e só mostra a contagem. Petalitas: sem extrato.

targets.queryText:
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT l.label FROM reason_labels l WHERE l.currency = f.currency AND l.reason = f.reason), f.reason) AS "Motivo",
  CASE kind WHEN 'creation' THEN 'Criação' WHEN 'destruction' THEN 'Destruição'
    WHEN 'transfer' THEN 'Transferência' WHEN 'exchange_in' THEN 'Câmbio (entrada)'
    WHEN 'exchange_out' THEN 'Câmbio (saída)' WHEN 'non_monetary' THEN 'Fora do dinheiro'
    ELSE 'Sem mapeamento' END AS "Tipo",
  CASE WHEN kind = 'non_monetary' THEN NULL ELSE SUM(amount_in) END AS "Entrou",
  CASE WHEN kind = 'non_monetary' THEN NULL ELSE SUM(amount_out) END AS "Saiu",
  CASE WHEN kind = 'non_monetary' THEN NULL ELSE SUM(amount_in - amount_out) END AS "Líquido",
  SUM(tx_count) AS "Transações"
FROM flows_hourly f
WHERE f.currency = '${moeda}' AND f.hour >= $__to - 604800000 AND f.hour < $__to
GROUP BY f.reason, f.kind
ORDER BY COALESCE("Entrou", 0) + COALESCE("Saiu", 0) DESC
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT l.label FROM reason_labels l WHERE l.currency = f.currency AND l.reason = f.reason), f.reason) AS "Motivo",
  CASE kind WHEN 'creation' THEN 'Criação' WHEN 'destruction' THEN 'Destruição'
    WHEN 'transfer' THEN 'Transferência' WHEN 'exchange_in' THEN 'Câmbio (entrada)'
    WHEN 'exchange_out' THEN 'Câmbio (saída)' WHEN 'non_monetary' THEN 'Fora do dinheiro'
    ELSE 'Sem mapeamento' END AS "Tipo",
  CASE WHEN kind = 'non_monetary' THEN NULL ELSE SUM(amount_in) END AS "Entrou",
  CASE WHEN kind = 'non_monetary' THEN NULL ELSE SUM(amount_out) END AS "Saiu",
  CASE WHEN kind = 'non_monetary' THEN NULL ELSE SUM(amount_in - amount_out) END AS "Líquido",
  SUM(tx_count) AS "Transações"
FROM flows_hourly f
WHERE f.currency = '${moeda}' AND f.hour >= $__to - 604800000 AND f.hour < $__to
GROUP BY f.reason, f.kind
ORDER BY COALESCE("Entrou", 0) + COALESCE("Saiu", 0) DESC

panels.title: Últimas mudanças registradas
panels.description: Anotações (mudança de regra, correção de extrato), registradas com scripts/economy-annotate.js. Aparecem também no gráfico de massa.

targets.queryText:
SELECT ts / 1000 AS "Quando", COALESCE(currency, 'todas') AS "Moeda", label AS "O que mudou"
FROM annotations ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 6
targets.rawQueryText:

panels.title: Moeda: ${moeda} — massa, fluxos e concentração
Massa total — ${moeda} (12 semanas)
panels.description: Massa total da moeda. Marcas = mudanças registradas (anotações). Zinthos e Petalitas só têm histórico desde a primeira carga.

targets.queryText:
SELECT ts / 1000 AS time, total AS "Massa" FROM balances
WHERE currency = '${moeda}' AND ts >= $__to - 12 * 604800000 AND ts < $__to ORDER BY ts
targets.rawQueryText:

panels.title: Criado e destruído por dia — ${moeda} (período selecionado)
panels.description: Só motivos de criação e destruição (câmbio e transferências na seção própria), por dia econômico (04:00 BRT).

targets.queryText:
SELECT (((hour - 25200000) / 86400000) * 86400000 + 25200000) / 1000 AS time,
  SUM(amount_in) AS "Criado", SUM(amount_out) AS "Destruído", SUM(amount_in - amount_out) AS "Líquido"
FROM flows_hourly
WHERE currency = '${moeda}' AND kind IN ('creation', 'destruction') AND hour >= $__from AND hour < $__to
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT (((hour - 25200000) / 86400000) * 86400000 + 25200000) / 1000 AS time,

FROM flows_hourly
WHERE currency = '${moeda}' AND kind IN ('creation', 'destruction') AND hour >= $__from AND hour < $__to
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Quem recebe: ${moeda}
Quem recebe — ${moeda} (últimos 7 dias, por faixa de saldo atual)
panels.description: Contas com saldo > 0 em 5 faixas pelo saldo atual; quanto cada faixa recebeu de motivos de criação nos 7 dias antes do último dia carregado. Faixa com menos de 10 contas fica vazia (privacidade). Petalitas: sem extrato.

targets.queryText:
SELECT 'Q' || q || CASE q WHEN 1 THEN ' (menores saldos)' WHEN 5 THEN ' (maiores saldos)' ELSE '' END AS "Faixa",
  n AS "Contas", received_sum AS "Recebido", received_median AS "Mediana por conta",
  ROUND(100.0 * received_sum / NULLIF(SUM(received_sum) OVER (), 0), 1) AS "% do recebido"
FROM received_by_quintile
WHERE currency = '${moeda}' AND day = (SELECT MAX(day) FROM received_by_quintile WHERE currency = '${moeda}' AND day <= $__to)
ORDER BY q
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT 'Q' || q || CASE q WHEN 1 THEN ' (menores saldos)' WHEN 5 THEN ' (maiores saldos)' ELSE '' END AS "Faixa",
  n AS "Contas", received_sum AS "Recebido", received_median AS "Mediana por conta",
  ROUND(100.0 * received_sum / NULLIF(SUM(received_sum) OVER (), 0), 1) AS "% do recebido"
FROM received_by_quintile
WHERE currency = '${moeda}' AND day = (SELECT MAX(day) FROM received_by_quintile WHERE currency = '${moeda}' AND day <= $__to)
ORDER BY q

panels.title: Fatia recebida pela faixa de maior e de menor saldo — ${moeda} (12 semanas)

targets.queryText:
SELECT day / 1000 AS time,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN q = 5 THEN received_sum END) / NULLIF(SUM(received_sum), 0), 1) AS "Q5 (maiores saldos)",
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN q = 1 THEN received_sum END) / NULLIF(SUM(received_sum), 0), 1) AS "Q1 (menores saldos)"
FROM received_by_quintile
WHERE currency = '${moeda}' AND day >= $__to - 12 * 604800000 AND day < $__to
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT day / 1000 AS time,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN q = 5 THEN received_sum END) / NULLIF(SUM(received_sum), 0), 1) AS "Q5 (maiores saldos)",
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN q = 1 THEN received_sum END) / NULLIF(SUM(received_sum), 0), 1) AS "Q1 (menores saldos)"

WHERE currency = '${moeda}' AND day >= $__to - 12 * 604800000 AND day < $__to
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Câmbio e transferências
Câmbio e transferências (últimos 7 dias)
panels.description: Câmbio no RavenaBank e transferências entre jogadores, fora do criado/destruído. Transferência líquida diferente de zero = taxa do mercado (ex.: 5% do MARKET_TRADE some). Linhas fora do dinheiro = waifu confiscada na taxa de hospedagem (não mexe no saldo).

targets.queryText:
WITH cur(currency, nome, ordem) AS (VALUES ('zinthos', 'Zinthos', 1), ('petalitas', 'Petalitas', 2), ('runas', 'Runas', 3))
SELECT cur.nome AS "Moeda",
  (SELECT SUM(amount_in) FROM flows_hourly f WHERE f.currency = cur.currency AND f.kind IN ('exchange_in', 'exchange_out') AND f.hour >= $__to - 604800000 AND f.hour < $__to) AS "Câmbio: entrou",
  (SELECT SUM(amount_out) FROM flows_hourly f WHERE f.currency = cur.currency AND f.kind IN ('exchange_in', 'exchange_out') AND f.hour >= $__to - 604800000 AND f.hour < $__to) AS "Câmbio: saiu",
  (SELECT SUM(amount_in - amount_out) FROM flows_hourly f WHERE f.currency = cur.currency AND f.kind IN ('exchange_in', 'exchange_out') AND f.hour >= $__to - 604800000 AND f.hour < $__to) AS "Câmbio: líquido",
  (SELECT SUM(amount_in) FROM flows_hourly f WHERE f.currency = cur.currency AND f.kind = 'transfer' AND f.hour >= $__to - 604800000 AND f.hour < $__to) AS "Transferido entre jogadores",
  (SELECT SUM(amount_in - amount_out) FROM flows_hourly f WHERE f.currency = cur.currency AND f.kind = 'transfer' AND f.hour >= $__to - 604800000 AND f.hour < $__to) AS "Transferência: líquido (taxa)",
  (SELECT SUM(tx_count) FROM flows_hourly f WHERE f.currency = cur.currency AND f.kind = 'non_monetary' AND f.hour >= $__to - 604800000 AND f.hour < $__to) AS "Linhas fora do dinheiro"
FROM cur ORDER BY cur.ordem
targets.rawQueryText:
WITH cur(currency, nome, ordem) AS (VALUES ('zinthos', 'Zinthos', 1), ('petalitas', 'Petalitas', 2), ('runas', 'Runas', 3))
SELECT cur.nome AS "Moeda",
  (SELECT SUM(amount_in) FROM flows_hourly f WHERE f.currency = cur.currency AND f.kind IN ('exchange_in', 'exchange_out') AND f.hour >= $__to - 604800000 AND f.hour < $__to) AS "Câmbio: entrou",
  (SELECT SUM(amount_out) FROM flows_hourly f WHERE f.currency = cur.currency AND f.kind IN ('exchange_in', 'exchange_out') AND f.hour >= $__to - 604800000 AND f.hour < $__to) AS "Câmbio: saiu",
  (SELECT SUM(amount_in - amount_out) FROM flows_hourly f WHERE f.currency = cur.currency AND f.kind IN ('exchange_in', 'exchange_out') AND f.hour >= $__to - 604800000 AND f.hour < $__to) AS "Câmbio: líquido",
  (SELECT SUM(amount_in) FROM flows_hourly f WHERE f.currency = cur.currency AND f.kind = 'transfer' AND f.hour >= $__to - 604800000 AND f.hour < $__to) AS "Transferido entre jogadores",
  (SELECT SUM(amount_in - amount_out) FROM flows_hourly f WHERE f.currency = cur.currency AND f.kind = 'transfer' AND f.hour >= $__to - 604800000 AND f.hour < $__to) AS "Transferência: líquido (taxa)",
  (SELECT SUM(tx_count) FROM flows_hourly f WHERE f.currency = cur.currency AND f.kind = 'non_monetary' AND f.hour >= $__to - 604800000 AND f.hour < $__to) AS "Linhas fora do dinheiro"
FROM cur ORDER BY cur.ordem

panels.title: Diagnóstico: moeda sem origem, mapeamento e cargas
Sem origem por dia — Zinthos (período selecionado)
panels.description: Por dia econômico (04:00 BRT): Δ massa entre o primeiro retrato do dia e o do próximo dia com retrato − Σ(entradas − saídas) das horas entre eles (linhas fora do dinheiro não entram). Dia sem retrato não some: o intervalo fica no último dia com retrato (ver 'Dias no intervalo' na dica). O dia mais recente só aparece quando o seguinte tem retrato. Petalitas: sem extrato, não há como calcular. Limites de cor PROVISÓRIOS, ponto de partida para calibrar.

targets.queryText:
WITH snap AS (
  SELECT currency, ts, total, (ts - 25200000) / 86400000 AS d,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY currency, (ts - 25200000) / 86400000 ORDER BY ts) AS rn
  FROM balances
),
op AS (SELECT currency, d, ts, total FROM snap WHERE rn = 1),
dl AS (
  SELECT currency, d, ts AS ta, total AS t0,
         LEAD(d) OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY d) AS d_next,
         LEAD(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY d) AS tb,
         LEAD(total) OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY d) AS t1
  FROM op
),
x AS (
  SELECT dl.currency, dl.d, dl.d_next - dl.d AS dias, dl.t1 AS total_fim,
         (dl.t1 - dl.t0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(f.amount_in - f.amount_out) FROM flows_hourly f
                               WHERE f.currency = dl.currency AND f.kind <> 'non_monetary'
                                 AND f.hour >= dl.ta - dl.ta % 3600000
                                 AND f.hour <  dl.tb - dl.tb % 3600000), 0) AS so
  FROM dl
  WHERE dl.tb IS NOT NULL
    AND COALESCE((SELECT available FROM ledger_status s WHERE s.currency = dl.currency), 1) = 1
)
SELECT (d * 86400000 + 25200000) / 1000 AS time,
  ROUND(100.0 * so / NULLIF(ABS(total_fim), 0), 3) AS "% da massa", so AS "Sem origem", dias AS "Dias no intervalo"
FROM x
WHERE currency = 'zinthos' AND d * 86400000 + 25200000 >= $__from AND d * 86400000 + 25200000 < $__to
ORDER BY d

panels.title: Motivos sem mapeamento (últimos 7 dias)
panels.description: Motivos que caíram em 'Sem mapeamento'. Mapear em src/services/EconomyAnalyticsMapping.js e subir MAPPING_VERSION: na subida seguinte a carga regrava o tipo do histórico inteiro.

targets.queryText:
SELECT CASE currency WHEN 'zinthos' THEN 'Zinthos' WHEN 'petalitas' THEN 'Petalitas' ELSE 'Runas' END AS "Moeda",
  reason AS "Motivo (cru)", SUM(amount_in) AS "Entrou", SUM(amount_out) AS "Saiu", SUM(tx_count) AS "Transações"
FROM flows_hourly f WHERE kind = 'unknown' AND f.hour >= $__to - 604800000 AND f.hour < $__to
GROUP BY currency, reason ORDER BY "Transações" DESC
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT CASE currency WHEN 'zinthos' THEN 'Zinthos' WHEN 'petalitas' THEN 'Petalitas' ELSE 'Runas' END AS "Moeda",
  reason AS "Motivo (cru)", SUM(amount_in) AS "Entrou", SUM(amount_out) AS "Saiu", SUM(tx_count) AS "Transações"
FROM flows_hourly f WHERE kind = 'unknown' AND f.hour >= $__to - 604800000 AND f.hour < $__to
GROUP BY currency, reason ORDER BY "Transações" DESC

panels.title: Histórico de cargas (últimas 50)
panels.description: Cada pedaço carregado (load_runs). '.received' = quem recebe (1x/dia); '.reload' = recarga manual (economy-reload.js).

targets.queryText:
SELECT ts / 1000 AS "Quando", source AS "Fonte", CASE ok WHEN 1 THEN 'ok' ELSE 'falhou' END AS "Resultado",
  window_from / 1000 AS "Janela de", window_to / 1000 AS "Janela até", rows AS "Linhas", error AS "Erro"
FROM load_runs ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50
